headings.reviewNote: Includes knowingly offering, conferring or agreeing to confer direct/indirect benefit for official conduct or violation of known duty.

headings.reviewNote: Topic label for the specified no-defense provision without restating it as general advice.

headings.reviewNote: Identifies classification topic without adding an imprisonment range.

headings.title: Conduct constituting acceding to corruption
headings.reviewNote: Includes solicitation, acceptance or agreement by public servant and both official-act and known-duty alternatives.

headings.title: Acceding to corruption offense classification
headings.reviewNote: Preserves class E felony in source, supplies no sentencing advice.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Public-servant solicitation, acceptance, or agreement for benefit and felony classification checked. This is not independent legal review.
